message.content: {"mechanism_id":"zero-delta-credit-decay","target_component":"success-memory update (M_F/M_CR)","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-01","trace_path":"lshade_canonical.py:run_lshade_canonical","function":"F7","seed":22,"metric":"late_success_rate","observed_value":0.824},"causal_hypothesis":"Equal-fitness acceptances (delta_f=0) contribute zero weight to Lehmer/weighted means yet still count as successes, biasing M_F/M_CR toward values that produced no progress and inflating apparent success rate.","algorithmic_change":"Replace binary success counting with a continuous credit c=delta_f/(delta_f+eps_scale) where eps_scale is a running median of positive delta_f; zero-delta trials get c=0 and are excluded from memory update but still logged as 'neutral'. Additionally, when c=0, apply a multiplicative decay to the memory slot's effective sample count so stale zero-credit entries lose influence over time.","mathematical_rule":"c_i = delta_f_i / (delta_f_i + eps_scale); if c_i = 0: skip M_F/M_CR update and set n_k = n_k * 0.95; else update Lehmer mean with weight w_i = c_i * |delta_f_i|. eps_scale = median of positive delta_f over last 50 gens.","expected_effect":"M_F/M_CR reflect only progress-producing trials, reducing stall_gen on F7 (target <30) and preventing F21's flat 786.565 plateau from being masked by success_rate=1.0.","failure_prediction":"If positive delta_f are rare (late F21), eps_scale collapses and c_i saturates to 1, reverting to standard behavior; decay may over-forget useful memory on multimodal F7.","ablation_plan":"Compare (a) full mechanism, (b) credit-only without decay, (c) decay-only with binary success, (d) canonical, across F7/F21 seeds 22/33/44, measuring stall_gen and best fitness.","nearest_known_methods":"L-SHADE weighted memory update; SHADE with success-history; fitness-delta weighted recombination (jDE variants).","implementation_requirements":"Track per-slot effective sample count n_k; maintain rolling median of positive delta_f; modify memory update loop to skip c=0 and apply decay; ~20 lines in lshade_canonical.py."}
